card.name: Digits in reference citations, plus scattered words
card.fires_on: Mostly the last digit of a volume or year in a journal citation, such as 23, 68 or 2012. It also fires on a few small words like 'to', 'will' or a comma in patient-advice text.

modes.label: Citation digits
modes.description: A digit inside a volume number or year in a reference list entry.

modes.label: Small words in advice text
modes.description: A linking word or comma just before a patient, doctor or pregnancy phrase.
modes.example: The doctor<< will>> ask about your symptoms and medical history.

card.plain: It mostly marks the last digit of a volume number or year in a journal reference, and sometimes a small word in patient advice.
